reason: The company reported a 62% YoY revenue increase and a 1,450 bps improvement in EBITDA margins, alongside confirmed plans to scale manufacturing capacity.
why_now: The earnings and capex expansion plans were confirmed in an exchange filing today, October 26, 2026.
source_headlines: Ather Energy Limited: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board at the meeting held today has considered and approved proposals for the enhancement of manufacturing capacity at the Companys factories located at Hosur, Tamil Nadu and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra (Factory 3.0- under construction).

Ather Energy Limited: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 26, 2026, titled "Ather Energy s total income up 62% YoY, EBITDA margin improves 1,450 bps YoY to 4.9% confirms plans to further enhance production capacity at Hosur and AURIC facilities".
